meta.name: brainstorming
meta.description: You MUST use this before any creative work - creating features, building components, adding functionality, or modifying behavior. Explores user intent, requirements and design before implementation.

copy.tagline: 在动手前理清需求与设计思路
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在开始工作前需要系统性地探索和明确需求
copy.tagline_en: Clarify requirements and design before implementation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically explore and define requirements before starting work

howto.what: 在开始任何创意工作前，Claude 会先通过对话了解你的意图、需求和设计，提出 2-3 种方案并给出推荐，然后呈现设计并获得你的批准，最后将设计文档保存到指定路径并提交。
howto.when: 当你提出任何创意任务（如添加功能、修改行为等）时触发。Claude 会在实现前强制进行设计讨论。

say.text: 我想给应用加一个用户登录功能，帮我设计一下。
say.note: Claude 会先了解项目背景，然后逐步提问细化需求。

say.text: 我需要重构数据导出模块，先做个设计方案。
say.note: Claude 会探索当前代码结构，提出多种方案供你选择。

howto.what_en: Before any creative work, Claude explores your intent, requirements, and design through dialogue, proposes 2-3 approaches with a recommendation, presents the design for your approval, then saves the design doc to a specified path and commits it.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you propose any creative task (e.g., adding features, modifying behavior). Claude enforces a design discussion before implementation.

say_en.text: I want to add a user login feature to the app. Help me design it.
say_en.note: Claude will explore project context and ask clarifying questions.

say_en.text: I need to refactor the data export module. Let's start with a design.
say_en.note: Claude will examine current code and propose approaches.
